DK: DraftKings classic scoring, read from contest rules.
PRIOR_WEIGHT_CAP: SELECTED on out-of-sample skill over 42 weeks and CONFIRMED on 28 weeks of which 14 could not respond to it at all. TEAM_VOLUME_PRIOR_GAMES: DECLARED pseudo-games of prior-season club volume.
THROUGH_SEASON: Hard holdout boundary. Every prior and rate is fitted at or before this season so 2026 can test the model.

HOLDOUT: every prior and every rate is fitted at or before 2025. The 2026 weeks enter only as current-season evidence with declared weight, never as training data, so forward-chained evaluation on unseen 2026 weeks remains honest.
